svg.title: MPSMA-DEIM detection pipeline
svg.desc: An example image enters the MPS stem and the four HGNetv2-B0 stages. The hybrid encoder receives the stride-16 and stride-32 features in the evaluated n model. The dashed stride-8 input is only active in the s configuration. The encoder feeds the D-FINE decoder to produce boxes and scores.
svg.metadata: Revision 44, Figure 1. Scientific source: FULL_FRESH.yml, S1 model configuration, Figure 1 label sheet, and manuscript section 3.1. Paper figure references: local academic-diagram atlas, DrivoR Fig. 1 (continuous paths and inline notation), TabICL Fig. 2 (operator notation and residual wiring).
